svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, #121212); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="cms-architecture" name="How Moks CMS fits together"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" background="#ffffff" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;" value="How Moks CMS fits together" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="700" x="20" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="readers" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=13;" value="Readers
(browsers, feeds, AI assistants)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="220" x="20" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="staff" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=13;" value="Admins, authors
and demo users" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="220" x="20" y="170" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontSize=12;dashed=1;" value="Edge
(Cloudflare, ingress)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="160" x="290" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="web" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="Moks CMS web app
(Next.js: public site + admin)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="240" x="510" y="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="redis" parent="1" style="shape=cylinder3;boundedLbl=1;size=8;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=12;" value="Redis
(sessions, cache bus)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="180" x="820" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="r2" parent="1" style="shape=cylinder3;boundedLbl=1;size=8;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=12;" value="Cloudflare R2
(media)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="180" x="820" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mail" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontSize=12;dashed=1;" value="Email
(SES / SMTP / Mailgun)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="55" width="180" x="820" y="230" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pg" parent="1" style="shape=cylinder3;boundedLbl=1;size=8;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=12;" value="PostgreSQL
(content, users, SEO data)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="200" x="230" y="300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="agent" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=13;" value="SEO agent
(CrewAI flows, ML, MCP)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="240" x="510" y="300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="llm" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontSize=12;dashed=1;" value="Claude, Gemini,
DataForSEO" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="55" width="180" x="820" y="310" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="google" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontSize=12;dashed=1;" value="Google Search Console,
GA4, PageSpeed" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="240" x="510" y="440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e0" edge="1" parent="1" source="readers" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="edge" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="staff" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="edge" value="sign in"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="edge" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="web" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="web" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="redis" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="web" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="r2" value="media"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="web" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="mail" value="invites, resets"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" edge="1" parent="1" source="web" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="pg" value="content"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e7" edge="1" parent="1" source="web" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;dashed=1;" target="agent" value="start flows"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e8" edge="1" parent="1" source="agent" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="pg" value="drafts, metrics"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e9" edge="1" parent="1" source="agent" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="google" value="daily sync"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e10" edge="1" parent="1" source="agent" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="llm" value="drafting, ML"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
